name: auto-assign
description: Safety net that assigns any still-unowned backlog items to available agents. Primary dispatch happens at backlog grooming (issues are assigned at creation); this low-frequency routine only catches stragglers.

routines.title: Auto-assign unassigned issues
routines.description: Safety-net routine-run checklist: review still-unassigned todo issues plus active implementation/review capacity, assign only the next actionable item that fits the default one-active-issue-per-agent and two-open-PRs-per-repository WIP limits, keep later roadmap work inactive, record evidence and next actions on the routine issue, then exit.
